title: IIBF IE&IFS Unit 18: Commercial Banking Operations, Basel III & PCA Framework
summary: Doctoral study unit on Section 22 Bank Licensing, Basel III Capital Adequacy (CRAR 9%, CCB 2.5%, Tier 1/2), LCR/NSFR norms, Prompt Corrective Action (PCA) triggers, and Corporate Governance.

blocks.title: IIBF Core Foundation: Basel III Capital Architecture
blocks.summary: Basel III norms protect the solvency of commercial banks by mandating risk-weighted capital buffers (CRAR, Tier 1, CCB) and structural liquidity buffers (LCR, NSFR) to withstand severe economic shocks.

blocks.text: 🏛️ 1. Basel III Capital Adequacy Benchmarks (RBI vs. BCBS)

blocks.caption: Basel III Minimum Capital Requirements (% of Risk-Weighted Assets - RWA)
headers: RBI Mandate for Indian Commercial Banks
rows: Paid-up equity shares, Statutory reserves, Capital reserves, Share premium.
CET1 + Additional Tier 1 (AT1 perpetual bonds, PNCPS).
Subordinated debt (min 5 yr maturity), General provisions/loss reserves (max 1.25% of standard credit RWA).
Maintained above minimum CET1 to absorb losses during stressed periods.
**Statutory minimum operational solvency benchmark in India**.

blocks.caption: LCR vs. NSFR Comparison
rows: Ensure bank has sufficient **High Quality Liquid Assets (HQLA)** to survive a 30-day acute stress scenario.
Ensure bank maintains a **stable funding profile** in relation to the composition of its assets and off-balance sheet activities.
$$\text{LCR} = \frac{\text{Stock of HQLA}}{\text{Total Net Cash Outflows over 30 Days}} \times 100$$

blocks.caption: PCA Risk Thresholds & Trigger Indicators (Revised 2022)
rows: Restriction on dividend distribution/profits remittance; promoters must bring in capital.
Mandatory actions of Threshold 1 + **Restrictions on branch expansion & domestic/foreign operations**.
Mandatory actions of 1 & 2 + **Appropriate restrictions on capital expenditure (capex)** and staffing.

blocks.content:
🎯 Top IIBF Traps for Unit 18:
1. **RBI vs Basel Minimum CRAR:** Basel is **8.0%**; RBI mandate for Indian commercial banks is **9.0%** (and **11.5% including CCB**).
2. **Small Finance Bank CRAR:** SFBs must maintain a minimum CRAR of **15.0% (Tier 1 min 7.5%)**.
3. **PCA Profitability Metric Removed:** Return on Assets (RoA) was **removed as a trigger indicator** in the revised 2022 PCA framework; triggers are **Capital, Asset Quality (Net NPA ≥ 6%), and Leverage**.
